content.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי בֹא יְשֻׁרוּן בְּקָדֵשׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ,
content.transliteration: Aḥarē vo yeshurun beḳadesh barne’a‘
content.english: After Jeshurun had come to Kadesh-Barnea,

content.hebrew: נֶאֱמַר לוֹ: "עֲלֵה רֵשׁ! וּבְכֹל אֲשֶׁר תִּפְנֶה תַּרְשִֽׁיעַ."
content.transliteration: Ne’emar lo: “ ‘alē resh! Uvkhol asher tifnē tarshi’a‘.”
content.english: They were told: “Go up, take possession! Wherever you turn, you will utterly triumph.”

content.hebrew: וּלְרַגֵּל אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ אָבָה, בְּמַאֲמַר רַב וּמוֹשִֽׁיעַ.
content.transliteration: Ulraggel et ha’arets ava, bema’amar rav umoshi’a‘.
content.english: They wanted to spy out the land, at the order of the great One, the rescuer.

content.hebrew: קהל: הֵן לֹא קָצְרָה יַד יוי מֵהוֹשִֽׁיעַ.   (ישעיהו נט:א)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Hen lo ḳatsera yad Adonai mehoshi’a‘
content.english: Cong. Behold, Adonai’s hand is not too short to rescue.   (Isa. 59:1)

content.hebrew: הוּטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי מֹשֶׁה, וַיִּבְחַר אַנְשֵׁי תוּשִׁיָּה,
content.transliteration: Hutav haddavar be‘enē Moshē, vayyivḥar anshē tushiyya,
content.english: The idea was good in Moses’s eyes, and he chose men of practical wisdom,

content.hebrew: אִישׁ אֶחָד אִישׁ אֶחָד מִכָּל־שִׁבְטֵי יָהּ.
content.transliteration: Ish eḥad ish eḥad mikkol shivtē Yah.
content.english: One man each, from each of Yah’s tribes.

content.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי הוֹדָיָתָם אֶֽרֶץ זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הִיא, וְזֶה פִּרְיָהּ,
content.transliteration: Ve’aḥarē hodayatam erets zavat ḥalav udvash hi, vezē piryah,
content.english: [But] after their acknowledgment that the Land was oozing with milk and honey, and this was its fruit,

content.hebrew: קהל: נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶֽשֶׁת רְמִיָּה.    (תהלים עח:נז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Nehpekhu keḳeshet remiyya.
content.english: Cong. They turned back, like an untrusty bow.  (Ps. 78:57)

content.hebrew: רֽוּחַ חֵן בְּפִי בִן נוּן וְכָלֵב, בֶּאֱמֶת שָׁקָֽדוּ:
content.transliteration: Ru’aḥ ḥen befi vin nun vekhalev, be’emet shaḳadu:
content.english: A beautiful spirit was in the mouth of Nun’s son and Caleb, who insisted on the truth:

content.hebrew: "אֵיךְ בְּדִבְרֵי אֵל וְהוֹדוֹ תִּכְחָֽדוּ?
content.transliteration: “Ekh bedivrē El vehodo tikh’ḥadu?
content.english: “How can you deny God’s words and His splendor?

content.hebrew: וּמֵאוֹיֵב, סָר צִלּוֹ מֵעָלָיו – לָֽמָּה תִּפְחָֽדוּ?
content.transliteration: Ume’oyev sar tsillo me‘alav – lamma tifḥadu?
content.english: And the enemy’s shadow is gone from him—why should you be afraid?

content.hebrew: קהל: אַךְ בַּיוי אַל תִּמְרֹֽדוּ!"    (במדבר יד:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Akh ba’Adonai al timrodu!”
content.english: Cong. Indeed, do not rebel against Adonai!”   (Num. 14:9)

content.hebrew: נָמַר רֵיחָם, עֵת בְּשָׁמְעָם מִשְׁפְּטֵי אֵל וְדִינָיו:
content.transliteration: Namar reḥam, ‘et beshom‘am mishpetē El vedinav:
content.english: Their fragrance went foul, when they heard God’s judgment and ruling:

content.hebrew: "חַי אָֽנִי, וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹד יוי עוֹלָם וּמַצְפֻּנָיו!"
content.transliteration: “Ḥai ani, veyimmalē khevod Adonai olam umatspunav!”
content.english: “As I live, and Adonai’s Glory fills the universe and its hidden places!”—
content.comments: As I live, and Adonai’s glory fills the universe and its hidden places. The language of God’s oath to punish the people.

content.hebrew: כִּי אָמַר לְהַשְׁבִּית זִכְרָם מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינָיו,
content.transliteration: Ki amar lehashbit zikhram minneḡed ‘enav,
content.english: For He said to destroy any memory of them from in front of His eyes,

content.hebrew: קהל: לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּֽרֶץ לְפָנָיו.  (תהלים קו:כג)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Lulē Moshē Veḥiro ‘amad bapperets lefanav.
content.english: Cong. If not for Moses, His chosen one, who stood in the breach before Him. (Ps. 106:23)

content.hebrew: חַי וְקַיָּם אָמַר עוֹד: "בְּאוֹת קַיָּם אוֹרֶֽךָ:
content.transliteration: Ḥai veḳayyam amar ‘od “be’ot ḳayyam orekha:
content.english: The living and enduring One said further: “I shall instruct you with an enduring sign:

content.hebrew: זַמֵּן לְךָ צִיצִת בִּכְנַף בִּגְדֶֽךָ, וְיָאִיר אוֹרֶֽךָ.
content.transliteration: Zammen lekha bikhnaf biḡdekha veya’ir orekha.
content.english: Prepare a ẓiẓith for yourself, on the corner of your garment, so that your light will shine.

content.hebrew: עֵינֶֽיךָ לְנִכְחוֹ יַבִּֽיטוּ, וְהוּא יַיְשִׁירֶֽךָ –
content.transliteration: ‘enekha lenikh’ḥo yabbitu vehu yayshirekha –
content.english: Your eyes will gaze at it, and it will set you straight—

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהָיוּ עֵינֶֽיךָ רֹאוֹת אֶת־מוֹרֶֽיךָ."   (ישעיהו ל:כ)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Vehayu ‘enekha ro’ot et morekha.”
content.english: Cong. And your eyes will see your teacher.”    (Isa. 30:20)

content.hebrew: קַוִּי עֲדָתִי, כִּי עוֹד אֲשִׁיבֵךְ אֶל רִבְצֵךְ.
content.transliteration: Ḳavvi ‘adati, ki ‘od ashivekh el rivtsekh.
content.english: Have hope, my community, that I shall yet return you to your pasture.

content.hebrew: קַוִּי, כִּי עוֹד אֲחַזְּקֵךְ וַאֲאַמְּצֵךְ.
content.transliteration: Ḳavvi ki ‘od aḥazḳekh va’a’amtsekh.
content.english: Have hope that I shall yet strengthen and fortify you.

content.hebrew: קַוִּי, כִּי עוֹד אֶרְצֵךְ, וְאֶל אַרְצֵךְ אֲרִיצֵךְ –
content.transliteration: Ḳavvi ki ‘od ertsekh, ve’el artsekh aritsekh –
content.english: Have hope that I shall yet find you favorable, and rush you back to your land—

content.hebrew: קהל: בְּרֶֽגַע קָטֹן עֲזַבְתִּיךְ וּבְרַחֲמִים גְּדֹלִים אֲקַבְּצֵךְ. (ישעיהו נד:ז)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Bereḡa‘ ḳaton ‘azavtikh uvraḥamim gedolim aḳabtsekh.
content.english: Cong. For but a brief moment have I abandoned you; but with great mercy will I gather you [back] in.       (Isa. 54:7)

content.hebrew: חזן: [בְּרֶ֥גַע קָטֹ֖ן עֲזַבְתִּ֑יךְ וּבְרַֽחֲמִ֥ים גְּדֹלִ֖ים אֲקַבְּצֵֽךְ:] בְּשֶׁ֣צֶף קֶ֗צֶף הִסְתַּ֨רְתִּי פָנַ֥י רֶ֙גַע֙ מִמֵּ֔ךְ וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עוֹלָ֖ם רִֽחַמְתִּ֑יךְ אָמַ֥ר גֹּֽאֲלֵ֖ךְ יוָֽי: (ישעיהו נד:ז-ח)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Bereḡa‘ ḳaton ‘azavtikh uvraḥamim gedolim aḳabtsekh. Beshetsef ḳetsef histarti fanai reḡa‘ mimmekh uvḥesed ‘olam riḥamtikh amar go’alekh Adonai:
content.english: Cantor. For but a brief moment I have abandoned you; but with great mercy will I gather you [back] in. In a little anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with eternal mercy have I had compassion on you, says your redeemer, Adonai. (Isa. 54:7–8)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיהו מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “the Lord of Hosts.”
